src/lib/components/DrawControl.react.js.description: Provide interactive map tools for drawing and serializing spatial study areas.

id.description: Component ID used to identify this drawing control and its callback outputs.

geometryTypes.description: Drawing modes displayed in the control: Point, LineString, Polygon, Circle, and Box (rectangle).

activeDrawMode.description: Active drawing mode; set to null to stop drawing. Bidirectional when changed by toolbar clicks.

position.description: Corner of the map where the drawing tools are displayed.

title.description: Accessible toolbar label and visible heading.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the toolbar control container.

buttonStyle.description: Inline styles applied to each drawing mode button.

drawnGeoJSON.description: Read-only: GeoJSON Feature emitted only when geometry validation succeeds.

drawnFeatures.description: Read-only: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of all drawn features, updated after drawing, editing, undo, or removal.

drawnWKT.description: Read-only: WKT geometry emitted only when geometry validation succeeds.

drawnTopoJSON.description: Read-only: TopoJSON topology emitted only when geometry validation succeeds.

geometryValidation.description: Read-only: validity, topology errors, and repair suggestions from the last draw.

snapToVertex.description: Whether drawing snaps to existing vector vertices.

snapToEdge.description: Whether drawing snaps to existing vector edges.

snapTolerance.description: Maximum snap distance in screen pixels.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied callback used to write component state back to the layout.

src/lib/components/DrawInteraction.react.description: Draw and validate OpenLayers features, then publish their serialized geometry to Dash.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

geometryType.description: Geometry to draw: Point, LineString, Polygon, Circle, or Box (an axis-aligned rectangle).

drawnGeoJSON.description: Read-only: GeoJSON Feature emitted only when geometry validation succeeds.

drawnFeatures.description: Read-only: GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing every currently drawn feature.

drawnWKT.description: Read-only: WKT geometry emitted only when geometry validation succeeds.

drawnTopoJSON.description: Read-only: TopoJSON topology emitted only when geometry validation succeeds.

geometryValidation.description: Read-only: validity, topology errors, and repair suggestions from the last draw.

snapToVertex.description: Whether drawing snaps to existing vector vertices.

snapToEdge.description: Whether drawing snaps to existing vector edges.

snapTolerance.description: Maximum snap distance in screen pixels.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied prop setter; internal, do not set from Python.

src/lib/components/LayerControl.react.js.description: Layer visibility, opacity, and stacking-order controls for map layers.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

position.description: Corner of the map where the control is displayed.

title.description: Heading displayed above the layer controls.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied callback used to write component state back to the layout.

src/lib/components/Map.react.js.description: Create an OpenLayers map and synchronize its view and click events with Dash.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

children.description: OpenLayers layer and interaction components rendered inside this map.

center.description: Map view center as [x, y] in projection's units (e.g. [lon, lat] for EPSG:4326, [x, y] in meters for EPSG:3857/projected CRSs). Bidirectional: updates on moveend and can be set from Python.

zoom.description: Map zoom level. Bidirectional: updates on moveend and can be set from Python.

projection.description: EPSG code the view is rendered in, e.g. 'EPSG:3857' or a custom code registered via `proj4Defs`.

proj4Defs.description: Custom proj4 projection definitions to register before the view is constructed, e.g. [{ code: 'EPSG:27700', def: '+proj=tmerc ...' }].

style.description: Inline CSS style object applied to the map container div.

clickData.description: Read-only: set on `singleclick` with `{ coordinate: [x, y], latLon: [lat, lon] }`.

undo.description: Increment to undo the latest draw or modify operation on this map.

redo.description: Increment to redo the latest undone draw or modify operation on this map.

canUndo.description: Read-only: whether this map's edit history has an operation to undo.

canRedo.description: Read-only: whether this map's edit history has an operation to redo.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied prop setter; internal, do not set from Python.

src/lib/components/Popup.react.js.description: Render Dash content in an OpenLayers overlay anchored to a map coordinate.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

children.description: Dash children rendered inside the overlay element.

position.description: Overlay position as [x, y] in the map view projection; null hides the popup.

positioning.description: Overlay alignment relative to its position coordinate.

offset.description: Pixel offset [x, y] applied to the overlay.

autoPan.description: Pan the map when positioning the overlay would place it outside the viewport.

className.description: CSS class applied to the popup content element.

style.description: Inline CSS style applied to the popup content element.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied prop setter; internal, do not set from Python.

src/lib/components/MeasureControl.react..description: Draw lines and polygons with live geodesic length and area measurements.

id.description: Component ID used to identify this measurement control in Dash.

units.description: Measurement units: metric uses meters, kilometers, and hectares; imperial uses feet, miles, and acres.

clearMeasurements.description: Increment to clear all completed and in-progress measurements.

position.description: Corner of the map where the measurement toolbar is displayed.

title.description: Accessible toolbar label and visible heading.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the toolbar control container.

src/lib/components/ModifyInteraction.rea.description: Allow editing vertices in a VectorLayer and report the updated features.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

layerId.description: Dash ID of the VectorLayer to modify; defaults to the first vector layer on the map.

snapToVertex.description: Whether editing snaps to vector vertices.

snapToEdge.description: Whether editing snaps to vector edges.

snapTolerance.description: Maximum snap distance in screen pixels.

preserveTopology.description: Revert polygon edits that introduce invalid topology.

modifiedGeoJSON.description: Read-only: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of the target layer after a modify operation.

modifiedWKT.description: Read-only: WKT geometry collection of the target layer after modification.

modifiedTopoJSON.description: Read-only: TopoJSON topology of the target layer after modification.

geometryValidation.description: Read-only: topology validation result from the last modification.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied callback used to write component state back to the layout.

src/lib/components/TileLayer.react.js.description: Render OpenStreetMap or custom XYZ tiles on the map.

id.description: The ID used to identify this layer in Dash callbacks.

source.description: Built-in tile source identifier. Currently supports "OSM".

url.description: URL template for a custom XYZ tile source, e.g. 'https://tiles.example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.png'.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied prop setter; internal, do not set from Python.

src/lib/components/VectorLayer.react.js.description: Load and interact with GeoJSON, TopoJSON, KML, or WKT vector data in an OpenLayers vector layer.

id.description: Dash component ID; also used by ModifyInteraction to target this vector layer.

data.description: GeoJSON Feature or FeatureCollection as an object or JSON string; embedded CRS metadata is honored, otherwise coordinates default to EPSG:4326. Takes precedence over geojson.

geojson.description: Backward-compatible GeoJSON Feature or FeatureCollection object alias for `data`.

wkt.description: WKT geometry string in [x, y] order; takes precedence over `data` and `geojson` when non-empty.

url.description: Remote URL for vector data; used when data, geojson, and wkt are not provided.

format.description: Data format for data or url: GeoJSON, TopoJSON, KML, or WKT.

dataProjection.description: Projection of input coordinates; defaults to EPSG:4326 unless GeoJSON embeds a CRS.

style.description: OpenLayers flat style or declarative style dictionary with fillColor, strokeColor, strokeWidth, radius, opacity, marker, and ordered rules. Each rule uses property, operator (==, !=, >, >=, <, <=, in, or notIn), value, and style. A marker may be a URL, an SVG string, or circle.

hoverStyle.description: Declarative feature style applied while the pointer is over a feature; supports fillColor, strokeColor, strokeWidth, radius, opacity, marker, and property rules.

selectedStyle.description: Declarative feature style applied to the most recently clicked feature; supports fillColor, strokeColor, strokeWidth, radius, opacity, marker, and property rules.

clusterDistance.description: Point clustering distance in screen pixels; set to 0 to disable clustering.

clusterMinDistance.description: Minimum distance in screen pixels between clusters; capped at clusterDistance.

declutter.description: Enable label decluttering, or provide a shared group name to declutter with other layers.

hoveredFeature.description: Read-only: GeoJSON Feature under the pointer, with coordinates in EPSG:4326.

clickedFeature.description: Read-only: GeoJSON Feature clicked on this layer, with coordinates in EPSG:4326.

featureCount.description: Read-only: number of features in the loaded source.

loadError.description: Read-only: message from the last failed data load, or null after success.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied callback used to write component state back to the layout.

src/lib/components/VectorTileLayer.react.description: Render MVT/PBF vector tiles with OpenLayers flat styles or Mapbox GL style documents and report clicked or hovered feature attributes.

id.description: Component ID used to identify this layer in the Dash layout.

url.description: MVT URL template containing {z}, {x}, and {y} or {-y}; ignored when urls is provided.

urls.description: Alternative MVT URL templates for load balancing; takes precedence over url.

projection.description: Projection of the vector tile grid; use the CRS served by the tile endpoint.

attributions.description: Attribution text or a list of attribution strings for the tile provider.

style.description: OpenLayers flat-style object used to style MVT features; ignored when mapboxStyle is provided.

mapboxStyle.description: Mapbox GL Style document used to style this layer's vector source.

mapboxSource.description: Vector source key within mapboxStyle; inferred when that document contains one vector source.

clickedFeature.description: Read-only: attributes of the vector-tile feature clicked on this layer, or null.

hoveredFeature.description: Read-only: attributes of the vector-tile feature currently under the pointer, or null.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied callback used to write component state back to the layout.

src/lib/components/TileWMS.react.js.description: Render a tiled OGC Web Map Service layer.

id.description: Component ID used to identify this layer in the Dash layout.

params.description: WMS request parameters, including LAYERS; changes refresh the source.

serverType.description: WMS server type used for vendor-specific HiDPI request parameters.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied callback used to write component state back to the layout.

src/lib/components/ImageWMS.react.js.description: Render a single-image OGC Web Map Service layer.

id.description: Component ID used to identify this layer in the Dash layout.

params.description: WMS request parameters, including LAYERS; changes refresh the source.

serverType.description: WMS server type used for vendor-specific HiDPI request parameters.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied callback used to write component state back to the layout.

src/lib/components/WebGLPointsLayer.reac.description: Render large GeoJSON point datasets with the OpenLayers WebGL renderer.

id.description: Component ID used to identify this layer in the Dash layout.

data.description: GeoJSON Point or MultiPoint FeatureCollection as an object or JSON string; embedded CRS metadata is honored, otherwise coordinates default to EPSG:4326.

style.description: OpenLayers WebGL style object; expressions such as get, match, and interpolate style feature properties. Changing the style recreates the layer; the default style is blue circles.

disableHitDetection.description: Disable WebGL feature hit detection for a small rendering performance gain.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied callback used to write component state back to the layout.

src/lib/components/WFSLayer.react.js.description: Load WFS GeoJSON features into an editable vector layer.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component and layer in Dash callbacks.

url.description: WFS endpoint URL; the service must allow browser CORS access.

typeNames.description: WFS feature type name (sent as typeNames for 2.x, typeName for 1.x).

srsName.description: Coordinate reference system requested from the service and used to parse response coordinates.

outputFormat.description: WFS response format; the component currently parses GeoJSON responses.

params.description: Additional GetFeature query parameters, such as count, bbox, or CQL_FILTER.

featureCount.description: Read-only: number of features loaded by the last successful request.

loadError.description: Read-only: message from the last failed request, or null after success.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied prop setter; internal, do not set from Python.

src/lib/components/SelectInteraction.rea.description: Select vector features and report the current selection to Dash.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

layerId.description: Dash ID of the vector layer to select from; omit to allow all selectable layers.

selectedGeoJSON.description: Read-only: current selection as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection in EPSG:4326.

selectedFeature.description: Read-only: first selected GeoJSON Feature in EPSG:4326, or null when nothing is selected.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied prop setter; internal, do not set from Python.

src/lib/components/WMTSLayer.react.js.description: Render a WMTS layer using its service capabilities to configure the tile grid.

id.description: Component ID used to identify this layer in the Dash layout.

url.description: URL of the WMTS GetCapabilities document; the server must allow browser CORS access.

layer.description: Layer identifier advertised by the WMTS capabilities.

matrixSet.description: Tile matrix set identifier; inferred when the capabilities advertise a single set.

projection.description: Projection code to select a compatible matrix set, such as EPSG:3857.

format.description: Tile image format; defaults to the first advertised format.

requestEncoding.description: WMTS request encoding, either KVP or REST.

dimensions.description: Values for advertised WMTS dimensions, such as TIME or ELEVATION.

attributions.description: Attribution text or a list of attribution strings for the tile provider.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied callback used to write component state back to the layout.
